plan.title: SSC CGL Tier 1 2-Week Intensive Plan
plan.summary: A high-intensity 2-week schedule focusing heavily on weak areas like Puzzles, English comprehension, and Reasoning, supplemented by targeted mock tests.

weeks.focus: Puzzles, English Comprehension, and Core Reasoning
weeks.milestone: Master foundational puzzle concepts and improve English reading speed and accuracy.

tasks.activity: Solve 20 basic linear and circular seating arrangement puzzles.
Read 2 editorial articles and solve 15 vocabulary questions.
Practice 30 relation tree problems and shortcuts.
Solve 2 Cloze tests and 10 sentence correction questions.
Practice 15 floor and box-based puzzle sets.
Practice 20 reading comprehension questions.
Take a sectional English and Reasoning practice test.
Review incorrect answers and note shortcuts.
Timed puzzle practice (10 sets in 45 mins).
Grammar rules revision and 15 error spotting questions.
Revise weak vocabulary and puzzle formulas.

tasks.topic: SSC CGL Tier I Full Test
tasks.activity: Attempt Full Test 1 under exam conditions and analyze mistakes.

weeks.focus: Advanced Puzzles, Vocabulary, and Full Mocks
weeks.milestone: Improve speed on high-weightage topics and build exam stamina.

tasks.activity: Advanced scheduling and categorization puzzles.
Solve 3 sets of Reading Comprehension.
Advanced coded blood relations problems.
Mixed reasoning mock practice (50 questions).
Parajumbles and Active/Passive voice practice.
High-difficulty puzzle mixed set (10 puzzles).
Attempt previous year shift paper (12 Sept 2025 Shift 2).
Full English section mock test and analysis.
Full Reasoning section mock test and analysis.
Review all flagged questions from previous mocks.

tasks.topic: SSC CGL Tier I Full Test
tasks.activity: Final full-length mock test and calm strategy review.

tips: Prioritize puzzles early in your study session when your mind is freshest.
Thoroughly analyze every incorrect mock test answer to avoid repeating mistakes.
Keep a vocabulary notebook to quickly revise new words daily.

form.goal: [TEST] I am preparing for SSC CGL Tier 1 in 2 weeks. Weak in puzzles and english. 2 hours daily.
